verdict.rationale: AI Gateway's own Logs page lets you filter requests and export the list as CSV or JSON, so gateway logs can be pulled out by hand and loaded elsewhere. Nothing in the evidence shows continuous or programmatic delivery to an external observability stack, or any trace export. missing for 10: automated log streaming/drains to third-party observability tools, trace export (e.g. OpenTelemetry), programmatic export API, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export gateway logs and traces to my own observability stack

citations.quote: You can also export the filtered list as CSV or JSON.
The Requests section displays summaries by project, API key, and a detailed log of all requests.
